firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently went on a date starts.
officialTieBreak: If players are tied for the most recent date, the younger player starts.
houseFallback: Choose randomly among any tied players, or among everyone if nobody can meet the dating criterion.
clarifications: The winner of the previous round starts the next round.
